capabilities: Copy size and color formatting from a selected canvas element
Copy only size or only color attributes
Paste copied formatting onto all selected canvas elements
Trigger copy and paste via context menu and commands
Show a status bar indicator when formatting is copied
extras: Full documentation is hosted on an external documentation site rather than in the README; the README includes a request for GitHub stars and sponsorships.
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in way to reuse an element's size and color formatting on other elements without restyling each one manually.
summary: Canvas tool that copies size and color formatting from one canvas element and pastes it onto other selected elements, like Word's format painter.
